# The Cupcake Desire

> Online bakery in Narre Warren, Victoria, baking hand-frosted cupcakes, cakes, macarons and cake slices to order and delivering across Melbourne Metro. Online orders only. No walk-in store.

## Key facts

- Kitchen: 352 Princes Hwy, Narre Warren VIC 3805, Australia (online orders only, no walk-in store)
- Phone: +61 3 9705 0051
- Delivery area: Melbourne Metro
- Lead time: order by noon for next-weekday delivery; orders after noon arrive the day after next. Cakes need 3 days’ notice; larger or custom orders need longer notice.
- Delivery fees: free delivery on orders over $100; otherwise typically $0 to $20 by suburb; outside Melbourne Metro by quote
- Dietary: eggless versions of every flavour (egg replaced by oil and water); vegan and gluten-free ranges available. Made in a shared kitchen that also handles nuts, gluten, dairy, eggs, soy and sesame, so not suitable for severe allergies or coeliac disease.
- Corporate: edible-logo cupcakes, mini cupcakes, cake slices and logo cakes for offices and events
